_about: Hand-checked extras merged into the wiki steps by convert.py. Each quest has 'tested' (true once the route has been played through in game; others show a note in the sidebar), 'progress' (the varbit or varp Quest Helper reads for its progress) and 'steps'. Each step entry finds the first step whose plain text starts with 'match'. 'npcs' are outlined, 'shop' items are outlined in shops with Buy 1 as left click, 'ground' items are marked, and 'target' is where the path leads (and is used when no matching NPC or ground item is in view). 'split' replaces one wiki step with several. Coordinates come from the OSRS Wiki's Map and spawn data, except the X Marks dig tiles, which come from RuneLite's clue scroll plugin (the wiki's map pins are a tile or two off). 'done' says when a step is finished so the guide moves on: 'have' an item in the inventory (checked for the next two steps too, so a step without a check is passed when a later one is done), 'lack' an item no longer in the inventory (current step only), 'varbit' reaching 'value' (current step only; the hopper lever sets MILL_FLOUR, as Quest Helper checks), 'haveId' an exact item id (the X Marks clue items CLUEQUEST_CLUE2-4 and CLUEQUEST_CASKET, which only arrive from a dig on the right tile), or 'arrive' within that many tiles of it. Quest start and completion are followed separately. 'progress' on a step lists the quest progress values at which that step is current: when the value changes, or after a login, the guide jumps there unless it is already between that step and the next step with 'progress' (this is how resets are noticed). 'via' are waypoints the path goes through first, in order; a waypoint on another floor is skipped until you are on that floor. 'digArea' lists tiles where digging is known to work; the whole rectangle they span is shown, together with tiles learned in game. 'objects' are outlined when near the target or a waypoint (such as the wheat, the mill ladder and the hopper). 'spot' is a tile to fill and label on its own, such as where to wait for the Cook so the pot can be grabbed right after. 'use' items are outlined in the inventory, and their 'useOption' is colored in the right-click menu (Empty on the compost). 'pick' south outlines and paths to only the southernmost of the ground items and objects: the egg in front of Fred's house rather than the chicken pen ones (its tile, roughly 3189,3279, is not in the wiki's spawn list), and the closest wheat. A target is only a placeholder until the step's NPC, item or object is in view (Fayeth's is 3195,3234). 'widget' is an interface component to outline (14286854 is InterfaceID.MagicSpellbook.TELEPORT_HOME_STANDARD). 'pathWithin' marks the step as arriving somewhere, such as the home teleport landing: until you are that close to the target the path and 'use' items are hidden and the 'widget' is outlined, and after it the other way round. 'leftClick' makes that option the left click on the step's NPCs. NPC and object spots for Cook's Assistant and the X Marks progress values come from Quest Helper (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper).
